tools.name: business_info
tools.description: Who Paradise Closets is: custom closets built to the customer's measurements, shipped anywhere in the US, DIY install (no installation service), and how to contact them.

tools.name: closet_price_estimate
tools.description: Ballpark price range for a custom reach-in or walk-in closet, using the same formula as the estimator on pclosets.com/quote. Give the ship-to zip_code to add a live freight estimate (LTL carrier quote, residential delivery with liftgate) and a total; otherwise shipping is quoted with the order. Fina

tools.name: how_to_measure
tools.description: Step-by-step guidance for measuring a closet before getting an estimate or requesting a quote.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send the customer's closet details to Paradise Closets so a designer contacts them with a quote (same as the form on pclosets.com/quote). Only call this when the customer asked to be contacted and agreed to share their details. Requires name, US ZIP, an email or phone, closet type and dimensions.
